fieldworkDocument.title: Measgaichte / Miscellaneous
fieldworkDocument.note: [NOTES: in IPA transcriptions, the fieldworker uses [w] for [ɯ].]

item.description: [sw:ɾu̜] Notes: eddy; a current of water running back contrary to the main stream. Occurs about half-flood.
[kɾɔʃɛ̃ṉ] Quotation: croisean na spaideadh. Notes: cross-piece at the top of the shaft.
